text: dsh-web-search-free 是一个为 DSH Web 客户端网页接口提供免密搜索和本地抓取能力的插件。它通过 Cordis bundle 注册搜索与抓取 provider，并将 web seam 路由到这些 provider。搜索会按配置依次尝试 DuckDuckGo Lite、DuckDuckGo HTML、Mojeek 和 Bing，提取标题、链接与摘要；本地抓取 provider 可读取 HTTP(S) 页面。适合希望让 DSH 搜索网页并获取页面内容的用户。搜索请求会直接发送到所选搜索引擎，不需要 API 密钥或账号。

dsh-web-search-free adds keyless search and local fetching to DSH's web seam. Its bundle registers both providers and routes requests to them. Search tries DuckDuckGo, Mojeek, and Bing; fetching retrieves HTTP(S) pages. Queries go directly to search engines; no API key is needed.
想让 DSH 不用付费搜索 API 也能查网页。
帮我用几个公开搜索引擎查资料，失败时自动换一个。
我想让 DSH 根据搜索结果继续读取网页内容。
dsh-web-search-free 的功能「免密网页搜索」：web_search provider 依次查询 DuckDuckGo、Mojeek 和 Bing，返回结果；某个引擎无结果或受限时继续尝试后续引擎。
dsh-web-search-free 的功能「本地网页抓取」：fetch provider 可直接读取 HTTP(S) 页面并返回内容；是否向 agent 显示此工具还取决于 DSH preset 配置。
dsh-web-search-free 会把搜索词直接发送给选用的搜索引擎，Mojeek、Bing 与 DuckDuckGo；实现从本机发出请求，没有云端中转。无需配置 API 密钥。

dsh-web-search-free README · dsh-web-search-free：**Free, keyless web access** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). This is a DSH *bundle* that registers two local providers into the web seam (`ctx.web`):

dsh-web-search-free README · dsh-web-search-free：| Provider | Id | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `FreeSearchProvider` | `free-local` | powers the `web_search` tool by querying public search engines directly (no DeepSeek cloud, no API key) |
| `LocalFetchProvider` | `free-local-fetch` | powers the `web_fetch` tool by retrieving any HTTP(S) URL directly from your machine |

dsh-web-search-free README · dsh-web-search-free：It replaces `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek`, which requires a paid `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. Requests go **directly from your machine** to the search engine sites: no intermediary.
dsh-web-search-free README · Search engines：The provider tries the engines in order, one at a time, and uses the first one that returns results:

dsh-web-search-free README · Search engines：| Engine | Endpoint | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ddg-lite` | `lite.duckduckgo.com` | minimal HTML endpoint, usually the most stable |
| `ddg-html` | `html.duckduckgo.com` (POST) | the classic DuckDuckGo HTML endpoint |
| `mojeek` | `www.mojeek.com` | independent, privacy-minded index; strict rate limits on bursts |
| `bing` | `www.bing.com` | last resort: suspicious clients may receive plausible-but-fake SERPs with no error reported |

dsh-web-search-free README · Search engines：When an engine serves a bot-challenge page (HTTP 202/403/429 or a captcha page), the provider automatically falls through to the next engine. If **all** engines return zero results, `web_search` answers "No results found"; if all of them *fail*, the error reports each engine's reason.

dsh-web-search-free README · Search engines：> Note: engine behavior varies by IP and network — which engine responds best depends on your connection. The order is configurable (see below). Scraping is tolerated, not guaranteed: an engine may introduce bot-walls at any time.

dsh-web-search-free README · Installation：The plugin is a DSH **bundle**: it is installed into the `web` profile (`~/.dsh/profiles/web`), and its `cordis.patch.yml` layer is composed into the profile at every boot.

Requirements:
- DeepSeek Harness (the `dsh` command) installed.
- [pnpm](https://pnpm.io) on PATH for the official command below (`brew install pnpm`). Option B needs no pnpm.

dsh-web-search-free README · Option A — official command (recommended)：Run it from anywhere, pointing at the plugin directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-free-search-plugin
```

(or `cd` into the plugin checkout and run `dsh plugin --profile web add .` — a relative path is resolved against the directory you launch the command from, not against the profile).

dsh-web-search-free README · Option B — manual installation (no pnpm)：```sh
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules
ln -s /absolute/path/to/dsh-free-search-plugin \
      ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-web-search-free
```

dsh-web-search-free README · Activate: restart the server：Bundles are loaded only at boot. Installing does not touch a running server; stop it (Ctrl+C) and start it again:

```sh
dsh web
```

dsh-web-search-free README · What the bundle layer changes in the composition：- inserts a `web-search-free` loader row that mounts the plugin and registers the two providers;
- overrides the seam's `web` row: `searchProvider: free-local`, `fetchProvider: free-local-fetch` (the base layer points at `deepseek-official`).
section: What the bundle layer changes in the composition

dsh-web-search-free README · Verify：```sh
node test/smoke.mjs                       # live engine test, needs network
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -B2 -A10 "web-search-free"
```

In the dump you should see the `web` row carrying `searchProvider: free-local` (annotated `patched by dsh-web-search-free`) and the inserted `web-search-free` row with its engine list. After the restart, ask the agent something like *"search the web for the latest MLX news"*: the `web_search` tool should return real sources.

dsh-web-search-free README · Configuration：In `cordis.patch.yml` (the bundle row) or in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: web-search-free
  config:
    engines: [ddg-lite, ddg-html, mojeek, bing]  # fallback order
    timeoutMs: 15000        # HTTP budget per engine

dsh-web-search-free README · Enabling `web_fetch` as well (optional)：```yaml
- id: tool-web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
  config:
    fetch: true          # changed from false

3. select the new preset as the default (or per session).

From then on, the agent can also read the full content of the pages it finds.

dsh-web-search-free README · Option A — official command：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-search-free
```

pnpm removes the dependency from the profile, and the dsh reconciler drops `dsh-web-search-free` from `dsh.profile.bundles`.

dsh-web-search-free README · Option B — manual (if you installed manually)：1. In `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`, delete the `dsh-web-search-free` key from `dependencies` and its entry from `dsh.profile.bundles`.
2. Remove the link:

```sh
rm ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-web-search-free
```
section: Option B — manual (if you installed manually)

text: dsh-web-search-free README · After removal：Restart `dsh web` (bundles load at boot). Without this bundle, the seam falls back to the base configuration: `searchProvider: deepseek-official`. The official DeepSeek provider stays registered, so `web_search` works again only if a paid `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` is available (credentials store or environment); otherwise searches fail with a missing-credential error. The plugin's source directory on disk is untouched — delete it separately if you want it gone.

dsh-web-search-free README · Layout：```
lib/index.js          # Cordis plugin (apply/inject/name): registers the providers into ctx.web
lib/engines.js        # search engines + fallback chain
lib/fetch-provider.js # local HTTP(S) fetch provider
lib/html.js           # entity decoding, tag stripping, redirect unwrapping (uddg, bing ck/a)

Zero npm dependencies: only Node >= 20 (global fetch).

dsh-web-search-free README · Privacy：No telemetry, no API keys, no accounts. Every search is a plain HTTPS request from your machine to the chosen engine. Engines see your IP and the query, exactly as a browser would.
